contexts.text: It would be more easy to turn a night-owl into a dove, or a horned-owl into a bird of paradise...
It would be more easy to turn an owl into a turtle-dove...
Instantaneous reformation... would be like the turning of an owl into a dove.

Devils... abominate truth as horned-owls do the light of the sun... Satans do not abominate truth, but are averse to it; and therefore they may be compared to night-owls, when the former are compared to horned-owls.
Some seemed like night-owls... some like horned-owls.
He becomes like a night-owl, and at last like a horned-owl.
A man not born again, as to his spirit, is like a panther or an owl... and how can an owl be turned into a dove... CL 526:2.
The natural man separated from the spiritual is like an owl beside a peacock.
